subject: application shell + navigation parity for the NivXForge EDR plane

before.amp_route_shell: NivXForceConsole only — xdr-shell 0, xdr-topbar-search 0, no global navigation, no Administration/Management, its own second top bar
before.legacy_route_shell: XdrShell — global search, tenant pill, notifications, help, user, full INVESTIGATOR + ADMINISTRATION navigation, focus-mode overlay
before.consequence: opening Device Trajectory · AMP replaced the platform application with an EDR-only application

findings.GLOBAL_SEARCH: PRESENT but was HIDDEN from the EDR plane. XdrShell owns it (xdr-topbar-search -> /xdr/incidents?q=). No second search engine was built. It is distinct from the trajectory's own amp-filter-search, which searches endpoint evidence (IP, filename, SHA-256, process, command line, MITRE technique).
findings.GLOBAL_SHELL: PRESENT (XdrShell) — was simply not used by the EDR routes
findings.ADMINISTRATION: PRESENT — xdr-area-administration renders in the shell sidebar; it was hidden, not missing
findings.MANAGEMENT: PRESENT via the ADMINISTRATION area groups (Data / Detect / Platform governance entries)
findings.DASHBOARD_INBOX_EVENTS_ANALYSIS_OUTBREAK: NOT_APPLICABLE as Cisco labels. The NivXRay equivalents already exist and are used as-is (MSS Dashboard, Incidents, My Queue, Investigation Workspace, Evidence Explorer, Intelligence, Telemetry, Exposure, Detect). No Cisco label was copied and no placeholder route was invented.
findings.EDR_NAVIGATION: COMPLETE — 11 items: Overview, Detections, Device Trajectory, Process Tree, Campaign Story, Files, Network, Threat Hunting, Forensics, Live Query, Response
findings.DEVICE_TRAJECTORY_DUPLICATION: RESOLVED — the 'Device Trajectory · AMP' duplicate label is gone; 'Device Trajectory' points at the canonical AMP route
findings.CUSTOMER_TENANT_NAME: WAS WRONG, NOW CORRECT — the pill printed user.tenant || user.email, i.e. the analyst's e-mail where a customer belongs. It now shows the server-resolved customer with a dropdown of the authorised customers.

restorations_performed: NivXForgeConsole renders inside <XdrShell flush>; it no longer paints a second top bar and owns only the EDR sub-navigation
XdrShell focus mode extended to /edr and /xdr/edr so the global navigation collapses to the ☰ overlay and the trajectory keeps full width
customer/organisation cluster in the Cisco position (user icon · customer over principal · chevron), replacing the initials chip; Sign out moved into that dropdown
one theme truth: shell toggle and page toggle share localStorage nx.theme and an 'nx-theme' event
single canonical Device Trajectory entry in the EDR sub-navigation
changes_not_performed: no second global search, search index, entity resolver or search API
no invented routes and no placeholder pages to make the sidebar look complete
no Cisco product navigation labels copied into NivXRay
no redirect of the operational Device Trajectory into an XDR case
legacy Device Trajectory header controls NOT added to AMP (owner instruction)

entry_context_model.DIRECT_EDR: no incident named -> investigation=null, active_customer derived from the principal's authorisation scope (SINGLE_AUTHORIZED_TENANT / CROSS_TENANT_ROLE_NO_SINGLE_CUSTOMER / MULTIPLE_AUTHORIZED_TENANTS)
entry_context_model.XDR_PIVOT: incident named -> the SERVER reads the incident, checks it against resolve_tenant_scope, and INHERITS its tenant (active_customer.basis=INHERITED_FROM_INCIDENT)
entry_context_model.endpoint_reference_basis: workspace_cases.endpoint_campaign.hostname / endpoint_id — never a name or PID guess
entry_context_model.browser_trust: NONE — the client may name an incident and an endpoint; it may not assert a tenant. A ?tenant= parameter is ignored and never echoed.
entry_context_model.tenant_vs_investigation: tenant_scope answers who owns the data; investigation answers why the analyst is here. They are separate keys in the response and separate labels in the UI.
entry_context_model.tenant_switch_policy: while an investigation context is held the response states that switching would create tenant B + incident from tenant A and that the investigation context must be left first
entry_context_model.edr_tenant_boundary: v2_shadow_observations carries no tenant_id — EDR endpoint evidence is not tenant-partitioned in this build; customer context is authoritative for XDR case surfaces and is shown for provenance, not used to filter endpoint evidence

shared_implementation: services/session_context.py — tenant_context() / list_customers() / authorised_incident(); list_customers reuses services.dashboard_lenses._scope so the customer list and counts cannot drift from the incident queue (verified: 'default' = 241 open in both /api/xdr/rbac/session-context and /api/xdr/mss/customer-operations)
route_sweep: 11/11 EDR routes render inside the shell with exactly one top bar, no clipping and no console errors (test_reports/iteration_102.json)
